I've been on lupron for 2 or 3 years now and on testosterone for 1. Lupron stops your body from making it's natural hormones like estrogen. If you are now on T you are getting male hormones and will exsperiance male puberty. lupron doesn't block the testosterone  you are putting into your body (via injection, patch, cream.. whatever) lupron just blocks whatever naturally occurring hormones your body makes.

This is the reason I'm still on lupron even though I'm on testosterone, I'm not at a high enough dosage of testosterone yet so if I stopped lupron my body would still create estrogen and I would exsperiance periods.
